list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; facts we could not confirm in the game are labelled unconfirmed.

roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1-2
roadmap.text: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1 and 2. Take the optional missions (black icons with pink letters) when they appear, scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and do the one missable meditation in Chapter 1 before that chapter ends. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

roadmap.title: Chapters 3-4 and the character strands
roadmap.text: Play through Chapters 3 and 4 and their named missions. Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone as their strands open, and start the Strangers & Freaks strands across Leonida.

roadmap.title: Final mission and free roam
roadmap.text: Finish the final mission, then keep a save from before it. Free roam stays open after the credits, and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Everything on it can still be done after the story.

roadmap.title: Clean up: activities, collectibles, robberies
roadmap.text: Work the checklist: stunts, races, shooting range golds, drone races, challenges, card sets, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles and areas, then the robbery trophies and the odd one-offs. Keep cheats off the whole run, they switch trophies and saving off.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! unlocks the moment the other 54 are earned. PowerPyx rates the set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours; Push Square says 250 hours or more. No trophy needs online play and none needs a difficulty setting.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Plan around the long pole instead, which is A Long Road and its 100% completion checklist, and around the one missable meditation in Chapter 1. No trophy in the set needs online play, DLC or a difficulty setting.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Keep cheats off for the whole run.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation before that chapter ends.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks as the mission ends. Just play the story in order and it comes to you.
steps: Start the story and finish the mission Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the missable meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to meditate.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Both protagonists become playable together from around here, which opens up most of the side activities, so start scanning vehicles and studying animals whenever you pass them.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play, so there is nothing extra to prepare for this one.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway: there is no mission replay, and a chapter-start save is your only way back if you want to redo anything later.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4.
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and this gold unlocks with the credits. Make a manual save before starting it: free roam stays open after the story, but a pre-finale save is the safe way to revisit the endgame on your own terms.
steps: Save manually before the final mission.
Finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is automatic story progress, so just follow the mission markers in order.
steps: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Heist missions are story beats, so there is no extra requirement beyond completing it.
steps: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is automatic story progress.
steps: Finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners and the trophy unlocks when it ends. No extra step is needed beyond completing the mission.
steps: Finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy unlocks when it ends. The mission takes place around Vice City International Airport, which is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens later.
steps: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale.
steps: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, needing for example 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 15 of 18 meditation spots and 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it is all doable in free roam after the credits. This is the hardest trophy in the set and the long pole of the platinum.
steps: Finish the story to open the 100% checklist.
Work the checklist in free roam: missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries.
Check Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, long air time and the like, all counted as you drive and ride around Leonida. It is a pure grind that builds up on its own if you drive fast and take ramps and jumps whenever you see them, and it overlaps with the stunt work on the 100% checklist.
steps: Drive fast, take jumps and ramps, and chain near misses.
Track the count on the trophy progress bar.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone racing, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the side activities on offer. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample one of each type, which makes this an easy early trophy once the activities have unlocked.
steps: Open the activities around Leonida and try one of each of the 9 types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own target score or time, so treat them one at a time: learn the layout, then chase gold with steady aim rather than rushing. This is one of the two silver trophies that demand real skill rather than time, so leave it for after the story when you can retry freely.
steps: Visit the Shooting Range and open a challenge.
Beat its gold target; repeat for all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Drone racing is about clean lines through the gates rather than raw speed: cut corners where the course allows, avoid clipping gates, and retry a location until the win lands. All 14 can be done after the story.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race; repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Each race only counts once, so spread out: try a new race each time instead of replaying one you already won. Pick the faster vehicle you own for each race and learn the route on a first run before pushing for the win.
steps: Enter a race you have not won before.
Win it; repeat until 20 different races are won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing game: watch the line tension, reel when the fish runs toward you, and ease off when it fights hard so the line does not snap. Challenge Cal when fishing is available and out-fish him in the head-to-head.
steps: Find a fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to its end; you do not need a high score, just a full run. This is one of the quickest trophies in the set.
steps: Enter an arcade.
Play any arcade game through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand of missions through to his final one and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Side-character strands open as you meet them in the story; follow Andy's markers whenever they appear so the strand does not sit unfinished.
steps: Play Andy's missions through to his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand of missions through to his final one and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Like the other character finales, it is a strand you work through as its markers appear, not a one-off task.
steps: Play Kenton's missions through to his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand of missions through to his final one and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Keep an eye on the map for Billy's markers between story missions so the strand keeps moving.
steps: Play Billy's missions through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map; each one is a short chain of missions, and a strand only counts when its last mission is done. There are more than 8 strangers in the state, so you can skip the ones you dislike and finish the 8 you like best.
steps: Find a stranger marker on the map.
Finish that stranger's whole strand; repeat for 8 strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand of missions through to his final one and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Work his markers as they appear during the story and after it.
steps: Play Randy's missions through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand of missions through to his final one and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is the last of the five named character finales, so this one usually lands late in the story.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: the first spot is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth. In the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when she offers to meditate; that spot is reported gone once Chapter 1 ends. The last spots need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note that 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, accept the meditation.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida once both protagonists are playable.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting here means tracking the animal to its area, studying it, then taking the shot; a unique animal is a one-of-a-kind target, so check Bret's request for which animal and where it roams before you head out. The exact animal and location are not yet confirmed in the launch guides, so treat any map pin as unconfirmed until you see the target yourself.
steps: Take Bret's hunting request.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, houses and odd corners; a set only counts when every card in it is found, so keep a checklist of which cards you still need and sweep one region at a time instead of wandering. This is a pure collection grind with no skill check.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Finish 3 complete sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a photo-style collectible: find a marked spot, do the action, and move on. The fastest way is to fold it into your other travel, hitting WAiNK spots whenever you pass one, and then sweep the leftovers region by region at the end.
steps: Find a WAiNK It location.
Do the WAiNK It action there; repeat at 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are small goals spread across combat, driving, exploration and activities, and you only need 50 of the 80, so skip the ones you hate and finish the easy ones first. The 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, so this trophy lands on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Open the challenge list and pick the easiest ones first.
Complete 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. The trick is the escape, not the heat: get the stars with your partner in the car, then break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the wanted level clears. Do it in a fast car on open roads outside the city centre, where you can put distance between you and the pursuit.
steps: Bring your partner along and earn a 4-star wanted level.
Lose the wanted level and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a short route of 3 close shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay alive the whole time, so do not let it clear and do not get caught. A fast getaway car parked near each shop helps.
steps: Pick 3 shops close together and bring your partner.
Rob all 3 in a row while keeping your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery means finding and scanning a vehicle model you have not logged before, so variety matters more than volume: try new districts, new vehicle types and parked rarities instead of the same traffic. The 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy lands early on that road.
steps: Find and scan vehicle models you have not discovered yet.
Reach 100 different vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster: trigger Combat Focus when 5 or more are close together, and drop them all before the effect ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is a better stage than a lone patrol.
steps: Find a spot with 5 or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: get a plane off the ground without going through the normal departure. Steal a plane on the airfield and take off, or drive a vehicle onto the runway and lift off however you can. Expect the airport to fight back, so come with a fast plane and a clear runway.
steps: Get to VCIA airfield.
Take a plane up without a scheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the launch guides: the description reads like a dare to take on Rhinos, so the working theory is to destroy or survive against one. Treat this as unconfirmed until a guide pins the method down, and check the sources below for updates.
steps: Unconfirmed: the method is not yet pinned down by the launch guides.
Working theory: take on a Rhino tank and see the encounter through.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go quiet: enter without raising an alarm, take the goods without being spotted by staff, cameras or guards, and leave before anyone reacts. If you are seen, the attempt fails, so plan the entry and exit first and keep a save from before you walk in.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and save before entering.
Rob it without being detected by anyone.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a full job: get in, crack the vault, grab the take and get out clean before the response closes in. Do them one at a time and keep a getaway vehicle ready, since the escape is part of the trophy every single time.
steps: Find a bank vault to rob.
Rob it and escape; repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. The escape is part of the trophy, so have a fast car waiting before you strike.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Rob it, then escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have set foot in it, so the trophy is a map-completion exercise: drive the coast, the swamps, the Keys and the back roads, and check the map for any region you have never visited. It pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies, so do it while you hunt cards, WAiNK spots and meditation sites.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida.
Check the map for unvisited areas until all 52 are explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations in its own territory, so work gang by gang across the map and tick each one off as you hit it. The 100% checklist counts gang operations too, so this trophy overlaps with A Long Road.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob it; repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail and take it in. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the launch guides, so treat the spot as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a spot with a sea view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. The exact showroom is not yet confirmed in the launch guides, so treat any named showroom as unconfirmed until you test it; bring a sturdy car and expect a wanted level on the way out.
steps: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom.
Smash out through the front in the car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end of the game. You do not need a high score, just a completed game from the first frame to the last, which makes this a quick and relaxing trophy between bigger jobs.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about a partnership moment with mass appeal, and the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the launch guides. The description points at a partner activity that draws a crowd, so the working theory is a public moment with your partner rather than a private one. Treat this as unconfirmed and check the sources below for updates.
steps: Unconfirmed: the method is not yet pinned down by the launch guides.
Working theory: a public partner moment that draws a crowd.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game; PlayStation tracks a count up to 500. Choices appear in missions, conversations and side moments, so this one builds up simply by playing and picking options whenever the game offers them. It is a long cumulative counter, so do not chase it early, just keep choosing.
steps: Pick choices whenever the game offers them.
Keep going until the count reaches 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed the first time. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the launch guides, but the name says it plainly: fail an attempt at a task, then pass it on the immediate retry. Treat the precise activity as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.
steps: Unconfirmed: the exact activity is not yet pinned down by the launch guides.
Working theory: fail something once, then succeed on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. The description points at one of the game's weird world events, the kind you stumble on while exploring rather than chase on a map. The exact event is not yet confirmed in the launch guides, so explore odd corners of the state and check the sources below for updates.
steps: Unconfirmed: the exact event is not yet pinned down by the launch guides.
Working theory: find and witness a strange world event while exploring.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl a pedestrian over. The exact wording suggests a single clean hit, so line up a slow pass, time the swing, and do it somewhere with room to drive away after. The precise trigger is not yet confirmed in the launch guides.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee drive-by hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash at a cut; keep feeding bills through until the laundered total hits $250,000. It pairs with the robbery trophies, so do the laundering as the bills pile up rather than saving it all for the end.
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is earned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts, from clothes and food to weapons and vehicle parts, so this one builds up naturally if you buy gear as you play. If you are short at the end, vehicles and property-adjacent big purchases close the gap fastest.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, food and parts across the shops.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought as property, and each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, so this trophy pays for itself in storage. Save up through the story and buy them as you can afford them.
steps: Find a garage property for sale.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like around Leonida, bring them into the app's system and register them one by one until you hit 10. It overlaps with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good, so register the interesting ones as you find them.
steps: Find a vehicle worth keeping.
Register it in the Scooter Bros app; repeat for 10 vehicles.
